title: Indexing a fixed-length flat map chunk
statement: Let $l$ be a finite list over a type $\alpha$, let $g$ map each element of $\alpha$ to a list over $\beta$, and suppose every list $g(a)$ has length $c$. For any $i<|l|$ and $j<c$, and any default value $d\in\beta$, the element at index $ci+j$ of the concatenation of the lists $g(a)$ for $a$ in $l$, followed by a list $rest$, with default $d$, equals the element at index $j$ of $g(l_i)$ with default $d$.
